_readme: Categories requested for the scheduled category skill, in order. Each run: git pull, then if 'queue' is not empty, build the FIRST entry instead of choosing a category, and remove that entry from 'queue' in the same commit that adds the category. The fields below are suggestions in the same shape as data/<slug>.json; adjust budget_cap and specs to what the real Amazon listings show. build.py does not read this file.
